Cost: 500eb (Expensive)
Class: PQ Machine Gun
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Sling, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Everything it fires also counts as Explosive ammo, including the -2 to hit and no Aimed Shots. Single Shot fires a 3-round burst. If there aren't enough rounds for Single Shot or Autofire, either one empties the magazine. Reloading takes 2 Reload Actions. Without BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms, the wielder takes -2 MOVE.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
